main_text.l: cjusque defolatione, per annos Lxx duratură: quo ope-
re publicè ostendit nec eum cultum per se hominem
Deo conciliare, sine quo multi in exilio tamen Deo
placerent. Nec gratum fuisse sibi eum cultum sine fide
in Christum, salvatorem venturum: cum ejus instrumen-
ta hostibus conculcanda & profananda objiceret. Hinc
aliquis datus fidelibus, in captivitate degentibus, præ-
gustus temporis, quo sine cæremoniis templo alligatis
Deum colerent homines, illique ex merâ fide, sine
sacrificiis legis, placerent. 3. Abductione populi inter
gentes (quæ abhinc non amplius ignorarent legem &
ipsum [?] populi) præparavit Deus vocationem gentium; ut
potuerint postea legem & prophetas conferre cum annun-
ciatione euangelii. 4. Ablatione inhabitationis divinæ
majestatis à templo, & oraculorum per urim & Thum-
mim à populo, præsagiebat Deus instare alium revela-
tionis modum, quo vellet post castigationum consum-
mationem populum suum beare, eum compellaturus per
filium suum: nec non damna illa compensare majoribus
N. T. bonis, cujus œconomia sine istis querelis, quas ef-
fuderant sancti sub priori testamento, longè foret fua-
vior, & quoad methodum doctrinæ efficacior.

page.notes: The word in the parenthesis after "ipsum" is blurred ("fpem"); read as "ipsum" with [?]. The word "fua-vior" is broken at the line end and keeps its printed hyphen. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The printed "cjus" is kept as printed. Show-through from the reverse side is visible on the right and was left out. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
